ANTIRUST Gray.name: ANTIRUST Gray
ANTIRUST Gray.description: Oil-based primer for durability, smooth finish, and strong rust prevention.
ANTIRUST Gray.more_detail:
ANTIRUST Gray is an oil-based coating using natural or synthetic oils, known for its durability, smooth finish, and strong adhesion, specifically designed to prevent rust.

Coverage: [12 to 14 square matter/1 lit]
Finish: Semi-Gloss
Drying Time: ≈ [3 to 4] hours.
Recoat: ≈ [12] hours.
Application: Brush, Roller, Spray
